params._bAsset: Address of the ERC20 token to add to the Basket
params._bAssetIndexes: Mapping of bAsset address to their index
params._hasTxFee: Are transfer fees charged on this bAsset (e.g. USDT)
params._mm: Base 1e8 var to determine measurement ratio

collectPlatformInterest(MassetStructs.Ba.details: Collects the interest generated from the Basket, minting a relative      amount of mAsset and sending it over to the SavingsManager.

depositTokens(MassetStructs.BassetPerson.details: Deposits a given asset to the system. If there is sufficient room for the asset in the cache, then just transfer, otherwise reset the cache to the desired mid level by depositing the delta in the platform

handlePegLoss(MassetStructs.BasketState.details: Executes the Auto Redistribution event by isolating the bAsset from the Basket

params._bAsset: Address of the ERC20 token to isolate
params._belowPeg: Bool to describe whether the bAsset deviated below peg (t)                         or above (f)

migrateBassets(MassetStructs.BassetPerso.details: Transfers all collateral from one lending market to another - used initially      to handle the migration between Aave V1 and Aave V2. Note - only supports non      tx fee enabled assets. Supports going from no integration to integration, but      not the other way around.

params._bAssetIndexes: Mapping of bAsset address to their index
params._bAssets: Array of basket assets to migrate
params._newIntegration: Address of the new platform integration

negateIsolation(MassetStructs.BasketStat.details: Negates the isolation of a given bAsset

params._bAssetIndexes: Mapping of bAsset address to their index

setTransferFeesFlag(MassetStructs.Basset.details: Update transfer fee flag for a given bAsset, should it change its fee practice

params._bAssetIndexes: Mapping of bAsset address to their index
params._flag: Charge transfer fee when its set to 'true', otherwise 'false'

startRampA(MassetStructs.AmpData storage.details: Starts changing of the amplification var A

params._rampEndTime: Time at which A will arrive at _targetA

stopRampA(MassetStructs.AmpData storage,.details: Stops the changing of the amplification var A, setting it to whatever the current value is.

withdrawTokens(uint256,MassetStructs.Bas.details: Withdraws a given asset from its platformIntegration. If there is sufficient liquidity in the cache, then withdraw from there, otherwise withdraw from the lending market and reset the cache to the mid level.

addBasset(MassetStructs.BassetPersonal[].notice: Adds a bAsset to the given personal, data and mapping, provided it is valid

userdoc.notice: Simply contains logic to perform Basket Manager duties for an mAsset.          Allowing logic can be abstracted here to avoid bytecode inflation.
